scripts.build:main: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/main.cjs --external:electron && esbuild src/config.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/config.cjs && cp src/error.html dist/error.html
scripts.build: npm run build:main && node scripts/write-build-env.mjs && electron-builder
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:main && LINKCV_DESKTOP_ENV=development node scripts/write-build-env.mjs && electron-builder -c.productName=LinkCV-Dev -c.appId=cn.linkresume.desktop.dev
